localization.notes: Daily and weekly entries are authored as complete copy units so future locale feeds can restate tone without splitting rhetoric into fragments.

promotionPlaybook.purpose: Give teammates a copy-and-paste brief for event, deal, discount, or service promotion.
promotionPlaybook.note: Use the playbook when a promotion needs to be explained to someone who does not know the site well enough to improvise the structure.

event.structure: lead with what it is, when it happens, and why the room matters
event.proof: speaker, venue, time, and who else it is for

deal.goal: Make the offer legible and time-bound
deal.structure: state the deal, the savings, and the deadline in the first pass
deal.riskReversal: simple exit or low-friction next step

discount.goal: Reduce hesitation with a concrete savings frame
discount.structure: show the original price, the discount, and the net result
discount.proof: exact amount saved and eligible audience
discount.riskReversal: clear terms and a no-surprise promise

service.goal: Turn a service into an understandable next step
service.structure: state the outcome, the method, and the first conversation
service.proof: examples, scope, and a concise proof point
service.riskReversal: what happens if the fit is not right

promo.label: What changed
promo.title: Thirty-one folios, scanned for September 26
promo.summary: Follow a thread through the stack, open a folio, flip to its neighbors, or turn a sideways piece. Ask for the one that stays with you by card.
promo.why: Writing, drawings, and seasonal paint share the same returning stack. Five pieces open in high-res each week; form, price, and availability are settled in the reply.

promotion.audience: readers, artists, and collectors who want to look closely at the work or ask for a piece
promotion.offer: Thirty-one scanned folios to open by thread, and a chosen piece carried into the order card
promotion.proof: The September 26 shelf holds thirty-one scans, neighbor controls, thread filters, and five marked high-res views.
promotion.objection: Browse first. The reply to your card settles form, price, and availability.
promotion.urgency: The September 26 release is on the shelf; the high-res five change each week.

wonder.label: Cycle question
wonder.title: Who should set the site's tempo: you, the page, or the stylesheet?
wonder.summary: Rhythm authority is new this cycle. Choose an author, and the rail beside it plays the tempo that wins.
wonder.why: Practice: pick one author, read a few pages, and notice whether the rhythm helps or distracts.

promo.label: Release record
promo.title: Revisit the September 26 record
promo.summary: The B-cycle close and its receipts stay on Now while the next cycle builds on them.
promo.why: A completed close is the ground this cycle stands on.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: Which receipt still matters a cycle later?
wonder.summary: Pick one line from the close and follow it into its route. If it still helps there, it belongs in this cycle.

promo.label: Daily promo
promo.title: Keep a configuration that fits how you read
promo.summary: Presets, workflow, and climate stay in this browser. One change is enough to feel the page answer.
promo.why: Quick Start is the fastest useful control surface on the site.

promotion.audience: people who want the site to match how they actually read
promotion.offer: A browser-local preset, workflow, and climate you can keep
promotion.proof: Settings saves in this browser and the rest of the site already listens.
promotion.objection: It should change the page, not just document the knobs.
promotion.urgency: The first useful change is a preset.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: What if this page had a different climate?
wonder.summary: Climate is the attention posture. Try one, then leave — the site keeps it.

promo.label: Daily promo
promo.title: Make collaboration easy to imagine
promo.summary: Keep the call to action low friction: a card, a button, a short route, or a clear email path to follow.

promotion.audience: people who want a quick first conversation
promotion.offer: A direct opening for collaboration without heavy ceremony
promotion.proof: The contact route stays plain and open across the site.
promotion.objection: It should be easy to understand the next step.
promotion.urgency: A quick reply path lowers the cost of saying yes.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: Who would be surprised by the breadth of this site?
wonder.summary: Developers, illustrators, authors, and executives all need different cues. A rotating surface can bridge those expectations.

promo.label: Daily promo
promo.title: Point to the tool that reduces effort
promo.summary: The right entry point is often a small utility, a clear route, or a sample that lowers the cost of starting.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: What if the site behaved like a well-run studio?
wonder.summary: The interface can express rhythm, attention, and stewardship without pretending everything is static.

promo.label: Daily promo
promo.title: See the laminated folio stack
promo.summary: Collage, lamination, and seasonal paint return to the same surfaces. Thirty-one scans now show the stack; open a piece, follow a thread, or ask for one by card.
promo.why: Each scan keeps writing, drawing, and later paint together. The shelf leads back to the practice and onward to an order card.

promotion.audience: collectors, homebrew players, and people who already follow lore.land or RPG Wednesday
promotion.offer: Look through the scanned stack and ask about a chosen folio or a custom, story-led piece
promotion.proof: Thirty-one scans, six thread filters, five high-res views, and the order card are on the folio page.
promotion.objection: The reply settles the piece, form, price, and availability before an order is agreed.
promotion.urgency: The release set is on the shelf, with five pieces open in high-res each week.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: What if a homebrew pantry also had a physical object?
wonder.summary: A character, place, or motif from lore.land can become a laminated original, a print, or a collage.

promo.label: Daily promo
promo.title: See the layers the pages are built from
promo.summary: Design is the public map of the same surfaces Settings tunes: slots, palettes, and reading weather.
promo.why: The design surface is how the site markets its own layers without a separate brochure.

promotion.audience: people who want to see how the site is actually built
promotion.offer: A readable map of slots, palettes, and the same layers Settings can tune
promotion.proof: Design and Settings already share workflow, climate, and material language.
promotion.objection: It should feel like a usable system, not a style guide dump.
promotion.urgency: The layers are already live on the page you are reading.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: Which layer would you keep if you had to choose one?
wonder.summary: Workflow, climate, and attention posture are separate levers. The point is to pick one and feel it.

promo.label: Daily promo
promo.title: Give people a place to begin and a reason to stay
promo.summary: A homepage can do both: point to useful work and create enough atmosphere to invite a second look.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: What kind of collaborator would this site attract?
wonder.summary: The answer should be broader than one discipline. The structure can help people imagine themselves inside it.

promo.label: Daily promo
promo.title: The group streak pet has outfits now
promo.summary: 314 days. Share one small, otherwise inconsequential wonder — a leaf, a joke, a hat on the pet, a soup. Autumn is a season of small returns.
promo.why: The pet is visible state. The invitation is a tiny wonder, not a thesis.

promotion.audience: streak chats, Wednesday players, and anyone keeping an autumn rhythm
promotion.offer: See the 314-day pet and share one incremental, whimsical wonder
promotion.proof: /topics/mental-health/#streak-math names the count, the outfits, and the low-cost return.
promotion.objection: A streak is not a clinical result; it is a room that kept showing up.
promotion.urgency: Autumn is open; Wednesday is the repeating door.

wonder.label: Daily wonder
wonder.title: What tiny thing is still worth sharing this autumn?
wonder.summary: Not a thesis. A leaf, a soup, a hat on the streak pet. The site is for that kind of return.

promo.label: Weekly promo
promo.title: Configure the site you are already on
promo.summary: Appearance, density, and chrome are the same layers the pages use. Settings is where you keep a configuration.
promo.why: A kept configuration is more useful than a tour.

promotion.audience: people deciding whether the site is theirs to tune
promotion.offer: A browser-local configuration that the rest of the site already honors
promotion.proof: Presets, workflow, climate, and attention posture are named surfaces, not hidden flags.
promotion.objection: It should be obvious that a setting changes the page under you.
promotion.urgency: The first pass is a preset; deeper registers wait until something still feels off.

wonder.label: Weekly wonder
wonder.title: What would you turn down first?
wonder.summary: Attention posture is the quiet lever: how much the page asks of you at once.

promo.label: Weekly promo
promo.title: Make the work legible to a new teammate quickly
promo.summary: Good surfaces reduce onboarding time for developers, illustrators, and authors alike.

promotion.audience: people comparing a new route before they commit time
promotion.offer: A faster way to understand the software surface
promotion.proof: The topic register and operator atlas already organize the path.
promotion.objection: The first pass should feel legible, not clever.
promotion.urgency: A better map reduces the cost of onboarding this week.

wonder.label: Weekly wonder
wonder.title: Which gap in career breadth is the site ready to bridge?
wonder.summary: The site can welcome a person with senior relationships and missing context without shaming the gap.

promo.label: Weekly promo
promo.title: Show the starter kit for the decentralized team
promo.summary: Offer routes and tools that help someone imagine joining the work without a heavy ceremony.

wonder.label: Weekly wonder
wonder.title: What would a calm, premium, living homepage look like by Friday?
wonder.summary: The answer can change with the week while the shell stays stable.

promo.label: Weekly promo
promo.title: Turn curiosity into a clear conversation
promo.summary: A good weekly card can invite work, not merely attention.

wonder.label: Weekly wonder
wonder.title: What part of the site should feel newly alive this week?
wonder.summary: This is the place for a slightly stranger question than the daily slot.

promo.label: Weekly promo
promo.title: RPG Wednesday makes art around the lore.land canon
promo.summary: The group streak is 314 days and the pet has outfits. Wednesday is still art and story from the lore.land pantry. Bring one small, otherwise inconsequential wonder.
promo.why: The table is the practice; streak math names the 314-day pet; Art is where a scene can become an object.

promotion.audience: players, streak chats, and people who want a physical piece from the world
promotion.offer: Join Wednesday with one small wonder, then look at the folio worktable
promotion.proof: RPG Wednesday is the live table; /topics/mental-health/#streak-math names 314 days and outfits; lore.land is the pantry.
promotion.objection: Community art is not automatically folio inventory.
promotion.urgency: Wednesday is the repeating door; autumn is a season of small returns.

wonder.label: Weekly wonder
wonder.title: What tiny, otherwise inconsequential thing is still worth sharing?
wonder.summary: A hat on the streak pet. A leaf. A soup. Autumn is a season of small returns, not a thesis.
